key_pathways: Not a CYP substrate or inhibitor

caution_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
caution_supplements.mechanism: Theoretical induction of hepatic metabolism may reduce micafungin levels, though micafungin undergoes minimal CYP metabolism
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for reduced antifungal efficacy if co-administered; may consider alternative supplement

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May delay gastric emptying; micafungin is IV-administered but food interactions relevant for absorption of concurrent oral medications
caution_foods.action: No specific restriction as micafungin is given intravenously; ensure adequate nutritional status during treatment

monitoring_notes: Micafungin has minimal drug interaction potential due to lack of CYP metabolism and minimal hepatic involvement. Monitor liver and renal function periodically during prolonged therapy, particularly in patients with hepatic impairment.
